decision: Keep initialization after both original reservations and release before backing storage is freed. Only an extra blank and its line anchor changed; the first original following free remains at line 288. The adapter owns mapping slots for VdmSetPhysRecStructs used by VdmAddVirtualMemory; the production WOW clock page binds through that API.
